rules: 'latest Notion' is never an implicit build input.
A newer timestamp does not silently supersede this lock.
Changing this file is a substantive PR requiring exact-version review.
Code built against a different spec lock is a different review object.
An implementation-authority addendum composes with the package it names; it never rewrites or silently supersedes it, and its exact native pin is the only version the repository builds against.

A design-lineage successor records that a section of an already-frozen source (or of an existing governance source) is ratified; it is never executable authority, never replaces, narrows or silently supersedes a frozen pin, and its newer whole-page native pin is not a build input. An executable lowering composes with the package, cites the design lineage it lowers, and is the only recorded executable authority for the R1 stage-one presence chain.
